what_happened.line: Town counsel advised that 419 Whalen Road appears ineligible to connect to sewer under the bylaw, even though a betterment was paid; no vote was taken.
Counsel said changing the easement ban would take a Town Meeting vote, and the commission set the easement policy and the Whalen Road question to return at its next meeting.
The commission voted on the fourth-quarter 2021 sewer commitment and on prior minutes; the vote count was not audible in the recording.
Counsel described his retainer as a flat monthly fee set from past town expenditures, and his bill is running at or slightly over the budgeted amount.
The Elizabeth Street repair quote came in lower than first thought, with funds to be encumbered from FY21; a Bright Farms update was put on a future agenda.

why_it_matters: A property owner who paid a sewer betterment may still be unable to connect, so a paid assessment does not guarantee service; any change to the easement ban would reach residents as a Town Meeting vote.
The quarterly commitment is the sewer billing that residents pay, and counsel fees are a budget line already near its limit.
